title: 第21章 抬手斩杀命轮凶兽惊呆全场第22章 第二序列一拳
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
虚空大手印裹挟雷霆之势，火鹰鸾鸟刚刚抬起手，三百丈虚空大手印已经落下了。
“轰隆”
大地轰鸣，烟尘炸起。
一股恐怖气浪滚滚扩散。
那头火鹰鸾鸟当场被虚空大手印镇压.
下一刻，虚空大手印一抓，鲜血喷溅，鸟毛飞洒飘落。
大手印落下形成的气浪扩散，吹得在场顾景以及其他长生顾家子弟发丝飞舞。
然而，他们却没有感觉，只是眼睛呆呆望着虚空大手印落下攥紧的方向！
因为这头命轮境二层火鹰鸾鸟，此时已经被他们神子的大手印攥成了肉泥！
一头命轮境二层的凶兽，在他们眼前竟然被顾长歌这位神子，抬手就镇杀了？
嘶……！
这就是神子的实力吗？
同代当中，能抬手按下就斩杀命轮境二层的人有几个？
恐怕现在也就神子有这个实力吧。
顾景等长生顾家子弟一阵头皮发麻。
……
而在顾长歌斩杀命轮境二层凶兽时。
暂未获得积分，亦或者获得十几点积分，再或者获得几十点积分的顾家序列，他们令牌光芒闪烁！
顾长歌的名字瞬间冲上了第一！
同时顾长歌带领的第十队，也一下从第十窜到了第一。

看到这一幕，所有参加成人礼实力的顾家子弟懵了。
“这是……神子出手了？”
“卧槽，直接暴涨100积分，这是斩杀了一头命轮境凶兽鬼怪？”
“嘶~不愧是神子，强横！”
第三序列顾霜剑一剑斩杀虹桥境六重的鬼怪，看了眼令牌上双榜第一的顾长歌，脸上冷漠：“斩杀了命轮境吗？我也去寻一头命轮境斩杀。”
顾霜剑说罢，回头看向自已带领的队伍。
本来他想立马离开的想法微微收敛，内心无奈叹了口气。
他倒是想要一个人行动。
可现实不允许啊。
如若他离开，那试炼第三队可就散了。
那个时候族内如何看他？
不过，顾霜剑也是奇怪，以顾长歌性子，应该是和他一样的想法，可队伍积分可是得令牌凑在附近一起斩杀凶兽鬼怪才计算，那就证明顾长歌获得100积分，队伍中的顾家子弟都在的。
想不明白顾霜剑索性不理会，带着其他人快速猎杀凶兽怪鬼。
顾紫玉，顾潇潇等人亦是目光闪烁，想法各异。
而第二序列顾元。
此时他已经听到了顾长歌斩杀命轮境凶兽方向传来的轰鸣。
同时。
顾元也看到了令牌上顾长歌和第十队窜上双榜第一的排行榜。
“刚才是顾长歌出手了？”
“走快跟上！”

顾元冲着背后的试炼二队道。
……
顾长歌这边。
抬手斩杀这头命轮二层的火鹰鸾鸟凶兽，他没有任何心理波动。
如今他修为就是命轮境二层，而且还是九纹命轮的命轮二层，更别说功法乃是大帝境传承：虚空经，出手自然不同凡响。
content_en:
The big hand seal of the void was wrapped with the power of thunder. The Fire Eagle and Luan Bird had just raised their hands, and the big hand seal of the three hundred feet of the void had already fallen.
"Boom"
The ground roared and smoke and dust exploded.
A wave of terror spread.
The Fire Eagle Luan was suppressed on the spot by the Great Handprint of the Void.
The next moment, the big handprint of the void grabbed hold, blood sprayed, and bird feathers flew and fell.
The air wave formed by the falling of the big handprint spread, making the hair of Gu Jing and other Changsheng Gu family disciples present fly.
However, they didn't feel anything, they just stared blankly at the direction where the big handprint of the void fell and clenched tightly!
Because this second-level fire eagle and luan bird in the Life Wheel Realm has been turned into a pulp by the big handprint of their god son!
A ferocious beast on the second level of the Life Wheel Realm was killed by Gu Changge, the Son of God, with just a raised hand in front of their eyes?
hiss……!
Is this the strength of the Son of God?
How many people of the same generation can kill people on the second level of the Life Wheel Realm by raising their hands and pressing down?
I'm afraid only the Son of God has this strength now.
Gu Jing and other members of the Changsheng Gu family felt their scalps numb.
…
And when Gu Changge killed the vicious beast on the second level of the Life Wheel Realm.
The Gu family sequence that has not yet obtained points, or has obtained more than a dozen points, or has obtained dozens of points, their tokens are shining brightly!
Gu Changge's name instantly shot to the top!
At the same time, the tenth team led by Gu Changge also jumped from tenth to first.
Seeing this scene, all the children of the Gu family who participated in the coming-of-age ceremony were stunned.
"Is this... the Son of God taking action?"
"Damn it, your points increased by 100. Did you kill a beast and ghost in the Wheel of Life realm?"
"His~ He is indeed the son of God, so tyrannical!"
In the third sequence, Gu Shuangjian killed a ghost at the sixth level of the Hongqiao Realm with one sword. He glanced at Gu Changge, who was number one on the double list on the token, with a cold face: "Did you kill the one in the Life Wheel Realm? I will also go find one and kill it in the Life Wheel Realm."
After Gu Shuangjian said that, he turned back to look at the team he led.
His original idea of ​​leaving immediately was slightly restrained, and he sighed helplessly.
He would rather act alone.
But reality doesn’t allow it.
If he leaves, the third trial team will be dispersed.
How did the clan view him at that time?
However, Gu Shuangjian was also surprised. With Gu Changge's temperament, he should have the same idea as him, but the team points were calculated only if the tokens were gathered nearby to kill the ferocious beasts and ghosts, which proved that Gu Changge got 100 points, and all the children of the Gu family were in the team.
Gu Shuangjian didn't understand, so he simply ignored him and led the others to quickly hunt down the ferocious beasts and ghosts.
Gu Ziyu, Gu Xiaoxiao and others also had their eyes flickering and had different ideas.
And Gu Yuan in the second sequence.
At this time, he had already heard the roar coming from the direction of Gu Changge killing the beast in the Life Wheel Realm.
at the same time.
Gu Yuan also saw on the token list that Gu Changge and Team 10 had climbed to the top of the double list.
"Did Gu Changge take action just now?"
"Hurry up and keep up!"
Gu Yuan said to the second trial team behind him.
…
Gu Changge's side.
Raising his hand to kill the fire eagle and luan bird beast on the second level of the Life Wheel, he didn't have any psychological fluctuations.
Now that he has cultivated to the second level of the Life Wheel Realm, and is also the second level of the Nine-line Life Wheel, not to mention that the technique is inherited from the Great Emperor Realm: Void Sutra, his moves are naturally extraordinary.
